title: Session documentation system design
summary: Designed session-docs skill to complement beads task tracking with session-level context capturing decisions and user intent.

decisions.rationale: Keeps everything in beads ecosystem, avoids redundancy with separate docs folder
Simpler than schema changes, achieves same goal of capturing rationale
alternatives_considered: Add new rationale field to beads schema

decisions.rationale: Agent should track its own work to avoid confusion, not rely on prompts

decisions.choice: Decisions and rationale, user thoughts, actionable todos
decisions.rationale: Avoid redundancy with beads (what was done) and issues (next steps)

user_thoughts: User wants non-intrusive documentation that captures planning discussions like this one. Prefers consolidation in beads over separate systems. Key insight: the purpose is to help agents not get confused in future sessions by preserving decision context.

title: Morpho Midnight as a separate lending protocol
summary: Added contracts for Midnight through existing lending instructions and aggregator composition, with refreshed bounded offer plans for deferred execution. Tests exercise pinned upstream code and actual Base Midnight/SetterRatifier/Blue deployments; UI remains deferred.

decisions.choice: Separate morpho-midnight gateway with exact net cash borrowing and face-debt accounting
decisions.rationale: Fixed-term discounted financing has different quote, authorization, maturity and health semantics from Blue.

decisions.choice: Compose existing router, flash loans and aggregator gateways
decisions.rationale: Avoid custom Midnight taker callbacks while supporting leverage, deleverage and collateral/debt migrations.

decisions.choice: Publisher/key plan updates bounded by immutable user instruction limits
decisions.rationale: Lender liquidity can refresh without changing the user's price, APR, debt-unit, health or deadline bounds.

decisions.choice: Locally ratified maker offers on deployed Midnight with deployed SetterRatifier, Blue and real tokens
decisions.rationale: Repeatable matching despite insufficient sampled API liquidity; no core code replacement.

user_thoughts: User requested contracts first, then UI; Midnight should be distinct and support collateral/debt swaps, leverage, deleverage and Blue refinancing, ideally limit orders. User explicitly requested deployed-contract fork tests and simulated matching.
problems_encountered: Midnight requires an Osaka-capable runtime; added isolated locked Node/Hardhat runner while compiling Kapan contracts with repository solc 0.8.30/Cancun settings.
No beads tool or beads/bd executable available; related tasks could not be tracked through required tool.
The sampled live API borrow quote returned insufficient liquidity; tests use funded local offers on the fork.
CoW manager rejects same sell/buy token; pure refinance uses direct router execution.

title: Morpho fixed-loan frontend and offer-aware refinancing
summary: Integrated Midnight loans into the Morpho position group with fixed-loan headers and separate protocol execution. Added live market/offer discovery, bounded financing, per-slot risk calculations, refinance and aggregator actions.

decisions.choice: Display Midnight within Morpho while executing through morpho-midnight and distinct market/slot contexts.
decisions.rationale: Matches the requested portfolio organization without mixing Blue variable-debt accounting with fixed face debt.

decisions.choice: Match debt token and all selected collateral; bind executable lender offers to amount, maturity, APR and debt bounds.
decisions.rationale: Borrowed cash is smaller than the fixed debt due; health and execution caps must account for that difference.

decisions.choice: Expose immediate aggregator flows and refinancing; leave deferred orders disabled.
decisions.rationale: Long-lived financing requires an execution-time offer refresh service that this frontend does not provide.

user_thoughts: Midnight loans should appear in Morpho positions, clearly marked as fixed loans. Refinancing should discover compatible offers with terms and sizing.
problems_encountered: Morpho list endpoints cap pages at 20; cursor pagination verified against live API.
Frontend dependencies were absent; installed isolated dependencies for tests and preview. Full TypeScript check retains four unrelated Wagmi/core errors in existing files.
Beads tool and CLI unavailable; documented the session here without fabricating task IDs.
validation: Focused unused-variable and hook-order lint passed
Live local API: market discovery, executable quote payload and nonempty indexed positions returned HTTP 200
Browser inspected fixed-loan card and offer terms with repository styles
No live transactions or deployments performed

title: Midnight production builds and deployment preflight
summary: Installed immutable Yarn dependencies; production frontend build and forced compilation of all 104 Solidity sources passed. Narrowed and rehearsed the Midnight deployment on a local Base fork, preserving existing router/helper wiring and protocol views.

decisions.choice: Reuse live router/helper, deploy updated view router and Midnight gateways, enable writes last
decisions.rationale: Avoid broad deploy dependencies rerunning unrelated protocol configuration; existing immutable order triggers remain on their previous view router.

user_thoughts: Ensure all builds before pushing; deployment is needed to enable Midnight.
problems_encountered: Initial npm-only installation caused Wagmi conflicts; immutable Yarn install resolved them without lockfile changes.
Local DATABASE_URL absent; build passed with an unreachable localhost placeholder. Production requires a real configured database.
Full UI suite still has 37 failures and two suite-load errors in unchanged scaffold/Starknet and live Pendle tests.
Live signer is encrypted and requires local unlock. Beads executable/tool unavailable; recorded session directly.
validation: Production Next build with TypeScript enforced
